text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Orfevre's summer training camp was progressing all too smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh... Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...Just as expected. Your time is improving."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural for Dream Journey to be impressed.
Even with summer growth, it's rare for an Umamusume's physique to change drastically once matured in the Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, Orfevre continued to show steady growth day by day... and today, she broke all her previous records.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Don't be amazed by just this.
I'll surpass it in no time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she wants to do another run.
However, that would be overworking her.
I'd like her to cool down as is, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Or.
What do you want to eat after this?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: You put on a magnificent performance. Your glycogen depletion must be severe as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"How is it?
Do your legs feel heavy at all?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Somewhat.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. If that's the case, it might be best
to focus entirely on recovery today.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer, you think
the same thing, right?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: So, Orfe. As for the food...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, let me guess.
...A rice ball. And tuna mayo at that, right?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm reminded once again of Dream Journey's brilliance
and her deep understanding of Orfevre...
As a trainer, there's so much I can learn from her.
choice_data_list: (I've got to do my best too.)
(I have to do my best too.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Uggghhh...
...*sigh*, guess I'll take a break—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Did you see Orfevre-san run? She's gotten even better than she was at the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Are you kidding me?! Even more than that?!
Is it gonna turn out like... the battle for 2nd place behind Orfevre-san in the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, ...
...What is that even supposed to mean.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, she's a dazzling person.
However...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, one more lap!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having wrapped up training early gave us extra free time...
So, at Orfevre's request, we headed out into town.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
It is truly an honor
to partake in this with you!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Very well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I hear you all have grown
over this summer as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Here is thy reward.
I shall grant thee play.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainers
text_block_list.text:
...!
I-I am truly honored...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Like wanting to move her body and play, perhaps.
She's probably still full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I feel like there was
an entertainment complex around here somewhere..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Dream Journey handed me was
a flyer for an attractions facility.
There are all kinds of activities, but...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Is there anything here to my liking?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Search for it.
choice_data_list: Test of courage in the haunted house

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Apparently, there is an area in the facility where it's okay to destroy any piece of scrap left there.
choice_data_list: Looks like a great way to blow off some steam!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: There is no such thing.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Pulverize," is it?
You've piqued my interest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we arrived at the facility, but...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Phew...
choice_data_list: T-The shelf broke in a single kick...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Orfe.
Magnificent leg strength.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A simple matter.
choice_data_list: (It's a facility where you use tools to smash things, though...)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Ho, so you too...
harbored such impulses within.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who appeared was Tanino Gimlet.
She, too, is one of the greats who left her name in history as a Derby Umamusume.
choice_data_list: So you came to hang out too.
So you came to hang out too

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah. A little bird told me I could enjoy some top-tier destruction here...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
O arrogant King.
—I hope you will share the stage with me in a duel of elegance.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ho?
Stand as equals with the King, you say?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Divide the world, and conquer it!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And finally... why don't we decide
who will be the true king to claim it all?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...How presumptuous.
I shall crush that recklessness along with you.

text_block_list.name: Orfe & Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Fuhahahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Oh...! 
What tremendous wind. Not bad at all!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You do well enough,
for a mortal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside Tanino Gimlet, Orfevre
destroyed everything to her heart's content...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently there's a small haunted house, and the nostalgic ring to it caught my attention.
It sounds like a fun test of courage, but...
choice_data_list: What about Orfe... what about ghosts...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Be they the living or the dead, it matters not.
I shall make them all kneel before me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Let's see.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A decent way to kill time.
I shall watch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we came to check out
the haunted house, but...

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: Ugaaaaaaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"You there.
Get out of the way."

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: Ah... *inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I deeply apologize for breaking the immersion.
Forgive me if I am overstepping my bounds, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, next time
could you try jumping in from a blind spot?
I think Orfe would enjoy that more.

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: Ah, sigh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while now, the sheer intensity of the sisters has been turning the helpless zombies back into humans one after another...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Noooooooo!!
I told you to stay awaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Dashing in right there is Sweep Tosho...
A wonderful, celebrated Umamusume who has won multiple GⅠ races."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Small one.
What are you clamoring about?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
!
D-Don't look down on me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm scared or anything!
I just wanted to see the magic door—

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text:
Um, are you lost?
Want me to show you the way—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaah!!
Nooooo waaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Too loud.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre casually tossed the jacket
she was wearing onto Sweep Tosho's head,
covering it completely.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"You there, guide this fellow.
To that magic door or whatever it is."

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yes, sir!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Take the subject's hand and lead them.
Understood? ...I shall press forward."

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Now then, shall we follow suit?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It ended up not being much of a test of courage,
but I did catch a glimpse of Orfevre's
surprising gentleness.
